title: GPT-6 model routing and durable Herdr session recovery

statements.text: Use GPT-6 Astra for the OpenCode default, Plan, GPT Build, GPT command and OpenAI reviewer routes.
Use Opus 5.5 for Claude Build and its command while preserving the configured Vertex provider boundary.
Remove GPT-5.6 from active managed model routing, including smaller OpenAI helpers and Hermes; preserve historical evidence and accounting identities.
Use catalog-supported GPT-6 Sol for Builder and Scout and GPT-6 Luna for Explore and small-model work; do not invent an unavailable GPT-6 Terra route.
Repair paced startup so a supported concurrent restoration burst is not rejected as unavailable storage merely because other sessions are progressing.
Preserve unresolved exact-session restoration entries across capture and restart without overwriting occupied panes, duplicating sessions, or resurrecting intentionally closed sessions.
Do not restart or signal Herdr or existing agent sessions; the operator is manually reopening sessions and live recovery state must remain untouched during implementation.
Deliver only this session's changes through pull requests into main after required checks; preserve unrelated Discovery commits and untracked relocation work outside delivery.
A startup timeout does not prove lost conversation history; current health and surviving session metadata cannot establish the exact incident-time lock failure.
Separate source and fixture qualification from deployment and live restart qualification; release of the operator's no-restart hold is required before live recovery testing.
